behavior.preconditions.homeLocation.subt: The location shown on the map will be used for all location-based automations and to determine sunrise and sunset times. You can reset your home location by tapping the arrow icon in the bottom right corner.
behavior.preconditions.ignoreBatteryOpti: If battery optimization is turned on for the Hue app, we can't check if you're almost home. Exclude the Hue app from battery optimization to ensure your automations run properly.

The Hue app will ask to access your device location data in order to run location-based automations, including those based on sunrise/sunset. For these automations to run correctly, the app needs to access your location even when you're not using it. 

Please note that these location services make use of the Google Maps platform, which collects and receives data including search terms, IP addresses, and coordinates.
